interpretation: The sweep shows mathematically that plausible clavicle endpoint length/orientation can reduce bi-AC breadth far below a003, but the 50/60/70 mm SC breadth inputs are illustrative and not evidence-backed targets.
The only hard width conclusion retained is that a003 bi-AC (~481 mm) exceeds the stature-conditioned outer biacromial scaffold (~425 mm), which is anatomically invalid for a normal target.
Absolute SC/AC coordinates stay open until a direct SC-breadth/manubrial constraint or a landmark-compatible thorax/scapula solve is registered.
coordinate_convention_note: The component magnitudes are anatomical. HGPT world signs must be mapped using the established character basis (anatomical left +X, posterior direction verified separately) before writing Blender coordinates.
